evals.title: Init then build
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `policy.site` is true.
- `mkdocs-material` is installed.
- The workspace is scaffolded.]

Build the documentation website.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Run `python -m skore_skills site init`. - Run `python -m skore_skills site build`. - Name `report.html` at the workspace root as the file to open. It must NOT: - Put catalog skill ids, HITL, `G-PKG-NAME` / `G-ENV-MGR` / `G-SKORE-MODE` / `G-TABULAR` / `G-CV-SPLITTER`, or `python -m skore_skills` / `env add` in user-facing questions or the close narrative (trailing `G-REPORT-LOCATOR` / `G-AUDIT-FINDING` and unmanaged `pixi add` / `uv add` / `pip install` lines are allowed). - Run `notebook convert`. - Run `git commit`.
expectations: Run `python -m skore_skills site init`.
Run `python -m skore_skills site build`.
Name `report.html` at the workspace root as the file to open.

The response does NOT: Put catalog skill ids, HITL, `G-PKG-NAME` / `G-ENV-MGR` / `G-SKORE-MODE` / `G-TABULAR` / `G-CV-SPLITTER`, or `python -m skore_skills` / `env add` in user-facing questions or the close narrative (trailing `G-REPORT-LOCATOR` / `G-AUDIT-FINDING` and unmanaged `pixi add` / `uv add` / `pip install` lines are allowed).
The response does NOT: Run `notebook convert`.
The response does NOT: Run `git commit`.
The response does NOT: Load `add-python-package` for `jupytext` or `nbclient`.
